coverage: exact export-name to C++ symbol mapping plus brace-balanced source-body contracts where parsable; unknown fields remain unknown
notes: Aliases and macro-prefixed registrations map to their actual C++ symbols (for example free->ffree and status->HTTPRequest_status).
Direct anonymous/lambda cfunctions and returned closures are indexed as source sites even without export names.
Coordinate mentions and event assertions are source evidence, not an invented signature/default contract.
MCP exposes only authenticated, verified subsets; indexed source sites are not arbitrary-code execution.
